Test Change Notice
Project No.: 2026RSD03TL
Run/TCN No.: 001
Project Description:
ADNOC BAB UHTW/UHTW 4.750/4.750
Test Run Description:
• Pre-test work required on stationary and rotating seal faces.
- Waviness measurement on 1 location
- Taper measurement on 2 locations
- Roughness measurement
- Profile measurement
- Height stationary face (only carbon and SIC30)
• Install mechanical seals per drawing listed above
- OB: #1 and #2 / IB: #3 and #4
- when possible install thermocouple at IB and OB seal stationary face.
• Pressurize to indicated pressure, measure break-out torque. Repeat torque measurements after 10 minutes.
• Start Test Unit
• Stop test unit and measure break-out torque. Repeat torque measurements after 10 minutes.
• Post-test work Job and plug seal, required on stationary and rotating seal faces.
- Waviness measurement on 1 location
- Taper measurement on 2 locations
- Roughness measurement
- Profile measurement
- Height stationary face (only carbon and SIC30)
